jobs.title: Design Intern
jobs.description:

She/He will also support presentations of the line to merchants and sales teams in adoption and proto reviews.

Assist the Woman Designer Team in the following daily activities:

- Bachelor Degree or Diploma in Fashion and/or Design Arts
- Strong attitude and understanding of fashion product, style and graphic trends
- Highly creative with a clear understanding of the Guess Brand DNA
- Must possess the ability to handle multiple tasks/projects with adherence to deadlines and design calendar
- Team player
- Natural good attitude interaction with all departments involved in the product process
- Dynamic personality, fast thinker, positive attitude
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills
- Good knowledge of computer skills: Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop are mandatories; extensive computer experience in and any other graphic program will be a plus.

jobs.title: Designer Outlet
jobs.description:
The Designer will be responsible for researching and interpreting emerging fashion and consumer trends, translating them into commercial products that reflect the Factory Outlet brand identity and meet customer expectations. By identifying new product opportunities and developing commercially relevant collections, the designer will play a key role in driving the evolution of the assortment while collaborating closely with Merchandising and Buying, and Product Development teams. According to their level of expertise, the designer will independently manage advanced design activities and contribute to strategic product decisions.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

## Requirements
- Bachelor Degree or Diploma in Fashion and/or Design Arts.
- At least 3-4 years of experience in the same role and field.
- Strong knowledge of fashion and emerging trends.
- Strong attitude and understanding of fashion product, style, and graphic trends.
- Creative, with a clear understanding of the brand DNA, and a very pragmatical approach.
- Fashion eye with commercial awareness.
- Ability to handle multiple tasks/projects with adherence to deadlines and design calendar.
- Dynamic personality, fast thinker, positive attitude.
- Availability for traveling if needed.
- Sense of urgency and flexibility
- Fluent English.
- Good knowledge of computer skills: Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
- Extensive experience with Adobe CS software, including Illustrator and Photoshop
- 3D design skills preferred (Clo 3D).

## Benefits
- An International, fresh and dynamic working environment
- Physical & Mental Health programs, sustainable projects and workshop promoted by Guess Community
- Arts, sports and social events outside the office, thanks to our Guess Fun activities!
- Training & Development platform and paths
- Discount on our products both online and in stores

jobs.title: GTM Campaign & Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
GUESS is seeking an organised, proactive and collaborative GTM Campaign & Marketing Coordinator to support the marketing and campaign side of the global go-to-market process and associated product launches.

Working closely with Commercial & Buying Teams, Integrated Marketing, Content & Creative, PR, Social and CRM teams, you will help ensure campaign readiness, creative deliverables and marketing activation are aligned and delivered on time against the GTM calendar. Launching the right products, in the right category, at the right time. This role requires strong coordination skills, creative/commercial awareness and the ability to keep internal stakeholders moving in step with the wider GTM process.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

## Requirements
- 3–5 years' experience in fashion/lifestyle, retail or consumer goods marketing, ideally with campaign or GTM coordination exposure
- Understanding of the campaign lifecycle from brief to launch, phasing multiple product launches at once
- Excellent project coordination skills, comfortable managing multiple creative stakeholders and timelines
- Proactive relationship builder, confident gathering information across cross-functional disciplines
- Confident communicator, able to translate creative/marketing detail into clear GTM updates
- Strong attention to detail combined with commercial sense and brand awareness
- Collaborative, pragmatic and solutions-oriented with a strong sense of ownership
- Excellent organisational and follow-up skills
- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with AI-powered project management tools is a plus
- Fluent English; Italian or additional languages are an advantage

## Benefits
- An International, fresh and dynamic working environment
- Physical & Mental Health programs, sustainable projects and workshop promoted by Guess Cares
- Arts, sports and social events outside the office, thanks to our Guess Fun activities!
- Training & Development platform and paths
- Discount on our products both online and in stores

En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales et d'achat, le marketing intégré, le contenu et la créativité, les relations publiques, les équipes sociales et CRM, vous vous assurerez que la préparation à la campagne, les livrables créatifs et l'activation du marketing sont alignés et livrés à temps par rapport au calendrier GTM. Lancer les bons produits, dans la bonne catégorie, au bon moment. Ce rôle exige de solides compétences en matière de coordination, de sensibilisation créative/commerciale et de capacité à maintenir les intervenants internes en phase avec le processus plus large de GTM.

- Collaboration, pragmatisme et solutions axées sur un fort sentiment d'appropriation
- Excellentes compétences en matière d'organisation et de suivi
- Compétences avancées Excel et PowerPoint; l'expérience avec les outils de gestion de projet alimentés par l'IA est un plus
- Anglais fluent; italien ou langues supplémentaires sont un avantage

- Un environnement de travail international, frais et dynamique

jobs.description:
The Senior Content & Art Direction Specialist will join the Content & Advertising Production team, contributing to the creative development and hands-on art direction of fashion content across multiple brand touchpoints.

The role will translate brand positioning, creative guidelines and marketing priorities into compelling visual concepts and high-quality content executions across advertising campaigns, lookbooks, e-commerce, video, social media and digital platforms.

Combining strong fashion sensibility with a solid understanding of visual storytelling and commercial objectives, the position will play an active role throughout the creative process, from concept development and moodboards to hands-on art direction during production and final asset review.

The role will ensure a cohesive creative vision across different formats and channels, adapting visual narratives to specific communication and product needs while maintaining brand consistency and quality standards.

Creative Concept & Visual Development

Art Direction & On-Set Execution

E-commerce Visual Development & Quality Improvement

Content Integration & Cross-Channel Alignment

- Proven hands-on experience in the art direction of fashion content across photography and video productions, preferably in both editorial and commercial contexts
- Strong fashion sensibility, visual taste and understanding of contemporary brand aesthetics and visual storytelling
- Ability to independently develop creative concepts, moodboards and visual directions and translate them into effective content executions across different formats
- Solid understanding of styling, lighting, composition, casting, talent direction and creative production processes

- Ability to collaborate effectively with photographers, directors, stylists and cross-functional creative teams

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a self-driven and experienced professional with a strong understanding of social media, fashion and culture, and a refined eye for content. You will help shape how GUESS connects with audiences through digital storytelling, campaigns and cultural moments.

This is a role with a high level of ownership, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, cross-functional collaboration and the ability to drive projects forward from concept to delivery.

Your mission is to ensure GUESS digital content and channels reflect the brand’s vision and DNA through a social-first approach. You will translate campaign ideas into platform-native storytelling, bringing together cultural relevance, creative excellence and measurable impact. Most importantly, you will help shift GUESS from social supporting campaigns to social actively shaping them.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

## Requirements
- 7/8 years of experience in social media, digital marketing and/or communications within fashion, lifestyle, retail or another culturally relevant consumer brand
- Proven experience developing and implementing global or multi-market social media strategies
- Deep understanding of Instagram, TikTok and other relevant social platforms, including formats, communities, publishing workflows, paid amplification and performance drivers
- Demonstrated experience managing social media calendars, campaigns and multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, international environment
- Strong fashion, design and cultural awareness, with a refined visual sensibility and excellent taste. Able to translate trends and contemporary aesthetics into authentic, visually compelling brand content, particularly for platforms such as Instagram
- Strategic yet hands-on, able to translate big-picture thinking into actionable plans and drive effective execution from concept to delivery
- Strong understanding of organic and paid social media, and how they work together to support broader business and brand objectives
- Experience managing or mentoring team members, with strong leadership, communication and collaboration skills
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present strategies, performance insights and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders
- Strategic and analytical mindset, combining an understanding of creative storytelling and brand building with the ability to interpret social media performance and translate data into actionable recommendations.
- Experience using social media analytics, reporting and publishing tools, such as Sprout Social, with familiarity with content creation tools such as Canva
- Experience with AI tools and emerging technologies relevant to social media is a plus
- Fluent English and Italian; additional languages are a plus

## Benefits
- An International, fresh and dynamic working environment
- Physical & Mental Health programs, sustainable projects and workshop promoted by Guess Cares
- Arts, sports and social events outside the office, thanks to our Guess Fun activities!
- Training & Development platform and paths
- Discount on our products both online and in stores
